notes.title: Forest Heroes V1.0 Official Release!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, this is Hoochoo Game Studios![/p][p][/p][p][b]Forest Heroes[/b] has officially launched today, ending its 6-month-long Early Access journey![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/19773351e906ed6776d521fac6e746e86daaf410.gif"][/img][/p][p]We would like to sincerely thank everyone who provided valuable feedback and helped us grow the game during this time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Rule Change – "Flower"[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/7fff963056d29e6e2fc52bf73217ef43633d9b0d.gif"][/img][/p][p]From Curse Level 5 and above, a mysterious [b]flower[/b] will appear at the start of battle.[/p][p]It looks incredibly tempting to pull…
But what will happen if you do?[/p][p]Check it out in the game![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Hidden Act 4 “Dawn” Now Open[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/065ec053c08dae72c959b5992ca25da40c0280f9.gif"][/img][/p][p]Along with the official release, the hidden [b]Act 4: Dawn[/b] has been revealed.[/p][p]Beyond the “Long the Oak” stage, a [b]secret final area[/b] awaits—
only accessible to fairies who meet certain conditions.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Card Border Added[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/3197c42691bbb2cab7879a6af41a9e75e0b8a393.gif"][/img][/p][p]Units who achieve victory together with you will now have [b]card borders[/b] applied.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/e9ae7843412ee9595e8910e8b72e1be3668b4609.gif"][/img][/p][p]Units who survive and win a [b]Curse Level 15[/b] battle will receive a [b]gold border[/b] as a special honor![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New achievements added[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/3761001fcf012361a4207769246a7abb44309208.png"][/img][/p][p]8 new achievements have been added.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Buffer: Duration increased from 5 → 8 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Boomulina: Explosion radius increased[/p][/*][*][p]Rose Cupcake: Common → Uncommon[/p][/*][*][p]Heart Cupcake: Uncommon → Common[/p][/*][*][p]Voodoo Doll: Uncommon → Common[/p][/*][*][p]Rainbow: Damage increased from 10 → 30[/p][/*][*][p]Shampoo: Thorns gain reduced from 2 → 1[/p][/*][*][p]Charcoal: Activation time increased from 5 → 6 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Socks: Common → Uncommon[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New skill for Pale Elf [/b]: Skull Archer[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/243df2ee09b06f4e4f94503c024f34bd311114ba.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [i]Puberty Monkey[/i] was not affected by [i]Deceptive Arrow[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [i]Chubcheek Hamster[/i] did not give buffs to special units[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where self-destructing units like [i]Angry Rooster[/i] were not properly registered as died[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [i]Vulnerable[/i] applied to fixed damage like [i]Poison[/i] and [i]Bleed[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]And One More Thing...[/b][/h3][p]We're currently working on implementing [b]Steam Deck–optimized UI layouts[/b]
to provide the best possible experience on Steam Deck![/p][p]Since the game was designed with controller play in mind from the beginning,
we’ll make sure it feels great on Steam Deck as well.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you!
– Hoochoo Game Studios[/p]

notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement & Patch Notes v0.5.2
notes.notes:
Hello! This is Hoochoo Game Studios.

[h2]Official Release Date Announcement[/h2]

Forest Heroes is officially launching this coming [b]July[/b]!

The release version will include new [b]hidden stages[/b] that can only be accessed by meeting specific conditions, along with unique gameplay mechanics tied to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/56cb740185973dbfab88aac8957f96b775854aac.png[/img]

[h3][b]Steam Deck Support[/b][/h3]

You can now officially enjoy Forest Heroes on the Steam Deck!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/ef53e25094a6c4993a3230cb3ae838bead0327cb.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes - v0.5.2[/h2]

[h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]

[b]Custom Key Binding Support[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/b3d9a4ee3e5181590f8c9a6dac58ebad1afb86fc.gif[/img]
You can now customize your key bindings in the Options menu to fit your preferences.
*Currently not supported on macOS. We plan to add support soon.

[b]New Effects for Waiting Cards and Some Talismans[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/30cc6113bf0113d30c02ee11265ca2fa428c3c03.gif[/img]
– When using a [b]standby[/b] card, an effect will appear on your hand based on the card’s ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/2367da6666704d9acd0429dffea7c890bb5b5474.gif[/img]
– Visual effects will now appear on the hand or screen when certain artifacts are activated.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would disappear after switching from the reward UI to the stage info UI and back.
[*] Fixed an issue where the movement speed effect could not be reapplied to a unit.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/77468e7539d813bd149b146c2d139eb18b24aad2.png[/img]
We’ll keep improving Forest Heroes leading up to the official [b]July[/b] release.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Forest Heroes Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Hoochoo Game Studios.

Today, we would like to share updates on the progress and revisions of the roadmap we shared during the Early Access launch.

[h3]Updated Roadmap[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/6129fa5bb3c69924638613ceb3bac24f7bdf53b1.png[/img]

First, the planned four new battle themes have been fully implemented, and the Oak Tree stage has been revamped with new enemies.

Additionally, although not originally planned, we have introduced an update adding over 40 new artifacts.

Instead of focusing on keybinding, we have decided that adding new content would be more beneficial for improving the experience and gathering feedback. As a result, the new unit additions originally planned for April will be moved up and included in the next patch.

Look forward to meeting new animal friends in Forest Noctful!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/0534b7fe27502a7d9c13256fc3b2043f2b7ccea1.png[/img]
*The Cobra has taken the purple color, and the existing Tentacle Snake’s color has been changed.

We will continue to work hard to ensure smooth progress on future updates. Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Hello from Hoochoo Game Studios!

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]

[h3]40+ New Artifacts Added[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/112d2f5cb2de4430d300d3ae78c1ecffefbcfdcb.png[/img]
Based on the feedback we’ve received since the early access launch, we’ve decided to add a large number of [b]artifacts[/b]. These additions aim to improve the following aspects of the game:
[list]
[*] Provide a wider range of victory plans and playstyles
[*] Offer more ways for your team to grow stronger
[*] Enhance the utilization of existing keywords (poison, bleed, stealth, etc.)
[/list]
This large-scale addition was a challenging choice for both development and balancing, but we’re delighted to bring you a much richer experience. We have adjusted it so that an artifact is unlocked every time a curse is cleared.

[h3]Final Boss "The Oak" Reworked[/h3]
[b]The Oak[/b] was intended to be the ultimate challenge in early access, but its current skill set and unit usage up to stage 7 made it less threatening. We’ve reworked its skills and associated units to make the stage much more challenging and enjoyable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096904/84c6cdc980589a671df1e3a3363dc80cbddf0922.gif[/img]
[h3]New Components[/h3]
[list]
[*] New skill “The Pale Elf”
  - Void of Life
  - Dead-Card Pile
  - Condense
[*] New crown “Flask Crown”
[/list]

[h2]Minor Updates[/h2]

[h3]System Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed damage indicators have been added to some skills. Fixed damage ignores fortitude and evasion and is applied directly to the enemy.
[*] Some artifacts will no longer appear at stages that are too high or too low.
[/list]

[h3]Ally Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The charm duration of “Lurer Peacock” has been reduced.
[/list]

[h3]Artifact Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The effect of the artifact “Gold Flag” has been changed.
[*] The effect of the artifact “Delicious Cheese” has been changed.
[*] The artifact “Sandbag” now deals damage equal to the attack power of the “Stormer Mole.”
[*] The artifact “Snail Shell” has been changed from a boss artifact to a rare artifact.
[*] The effect of the artifact “Bubbles” has been changed.
[*] The mana gained from the artifact “Flute” has been reduced.
[*] The effect of the artifact “Chestplate” has been changed.
[/list]

[h3]Skill Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The cost of “Pale Follower” has been reduced.
[*] The health consumed and increased by “Infusion” has been reduced.
[*] The mechanics of the card “Buffer” have been reworked.
[*] The range increase provided by “Standstill” has been improved.
[*] “Rage” now deals fixed damage, and its additional scaling has been removed.
[*] The effect of “Wind Blast” has been changed.
[*] The cost of “Violent Shadow” has been reduced.
[*] The cost of “Trap of the Dead” has been reduced.
[*] “Trap of the Dead” and “Curse of the Dead” now affect areas.
[*] The mana provided by “Unearth” has been increased, and it now has an exhaust effect.
[*] “Desperate Charge” now deals fixed damage, but its damage has been reduced.
[*] The attack power increase from “Last Stand” has been reduced.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the exclusive artifact “Spoon” for the “Brave Baby Pig” was applied multiple times when continuing a game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Plant a Mine” skill created Fungus Mines that could remain on the field indefinitely.
[*] Fixed overlapping death triggers
[*] Fixed an issue where the artifact “Shovel” did not work properly.
[*] Multiple issues related to ally group HP bars have been resolved.
[*] Option save files are now excluded from Cloud Save.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could not be launched if the save file was corrupted.
[/list]
